reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: the cap is nominally mutual but keyed to "Fees" = the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, making it illusory and below the six-months'-charges walk-away floor.

The redline reaches the preferred position (greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable across the Agreement and all Order Forms, or USD 1,000,000) with a targeted edit to the existing sentence; using "all amounts" rather than the defined term "Fees" correctly neutralizes the narrow definition.

Mutuality language and the existing Section 21.3 Excluded Claims carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement, plus payment obligations not being damages) are left intact, so no duplicative carve-out sentence was needed.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, states the position and offers a sensible fallback (straight 12 months' charges across all Order Forms).
Deterministic checks all pass; the 0.325 changed-character ratio is justified because the cap basis itself had to be restated.
